title: Fix Erlang semantic relation correctness for server_flexible
description:
## Summary
Correct native Erlang extraction/resolution defects found by deep review: record field/update references, context-free MFA tuple false positives, tuple no_auto_import, remote atom whitespace, rpc:multicall overloads, and unreachable include fallback. The goal is precise review context for server_flexible, not broader grammar coverage.

## Steps to Reproduce
Run the focused minimal parser/resolver cases documented by the deep review against b768371.
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests demonstrate red on b768371 and green after the fix; record access/update relations are emitted; ordinary data triples do not become MFA references; supported static MFA contexts remain; BIF/remote/rpc/include cases resolve conservatively; focused Erlang tests pass.
close_reason: Semantic extraction/resolution hard stops fixed and independently rechecked; full Python 3.13 suite passed.

title: Make Erlang graph lifecycle deterministic and atomic
description:
## Summary
Fix upgrade migration, repository-root ownership, atomic relation reconciliation, fatal propagation, exactly-once execution, layout-only updates, and identity metadata behavior so every build/update/watch/forget/postprocess path converges.

## Steps to Reproduce
Use old/mixed graph fixtures, injected TESTED_BY failure, nested OTP layout postprocess, duplicate reconciliation call counting, and rebar.config-only incremental updates against b768371.
acceptance_criteria: Old graphs with repository Erlang sources force one full rebuild; explicit or stored canonical repo root is used safely; resolver and TESTED_BY roll back together; fatal reaches user/watch boundaries; each entry point reconciles exactly once; layout-only updates refresh derived state; unrelated parse errors do not cause permanent Erlang rebuild loops.
notes: Final ship-gate regressions reopened this lifecycle issue: standalone postprocess must enforce identity migration, automatic update must see untracked Erlang layout config, forget must exclude erlang_ls.config and reject mismatched shared-database ownership, and watch must retry derived postprocessing after failure.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Reject generic-only semantic execution as adoption success
description: The adoption evaluator must not treat the always-on Generic adapter as proof that semantic adapters executed. Restrict semantic execution success to declared non-generic adapters and add a regression test for a generic-only envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Generic-only lifecycle envelopes remain invalid for semantic execution; a declared external adapter with explicit success can satisfy the execution check; focused evaluator tests pass.
close_reason: Restricted semantic execution evidence to declared non-generic adapters and added generic-only regression coverage.

title: Implement executable server_flexible Erlang adoption evaluation
description: Replace evaluator scaffold with repeatable graph/lifecycle runner, score corpus precision/recall/impact/latency, and check in adoption report only from a clean pinned target baseline.
notes: Implemented in dfa0406. The evaluator is executable, read-only, fail-closed, validates result integrity, and emits JSON/Markdown reports. Focused evaluator tests pass; the default server_flexible run remains blocked by target revision/dirty/submodule/toolchain drift, so adoption is not claimed.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Add execution manifests and hermetic boundaries for Erlang adapters
description: Define and enforce reviewable manifests for ELP, rebar3 xref, and Dialyzer. Validate command allowlists, cwd/filesystem/network policy, and return observable unavailable/degraded status when no valid policy exists.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Reject foreign checkout paths at lifecycle input boundaries
description: Prevent forget_files and incremental/watch updates from mutating files outside the requested repository when a shared GraphStore contains mixed roots. Add mixed-root regression coverage and make legacy Erlang projection cleanup fail closed.
close_reason: Implemented per-target repository ownership checks, fail-closed legacy projection cleanup, scoped integration metadata, and regression tests.

title: Integrate Erlang semantic evidence across graph lifecycle
description: Persist revision-keyed Erlang adapter evidence and expose it through build, incremental update, watch, forget, standalone postprocess, and normal query/review responses without weakening Generic fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Generic indexing remains usable when tools are unavailable; enabled adapter evidence and diagnostics are persisted, stale evidence is removed, lifecycle paths converge, and query/review responses expose provenance.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Integrate server_flexible manifest and Erlang evaluation corpus
description: Freeze the target repository/toolchain/generated-data manifest and add repeatable golden cases and performance/adoption measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Corpus cases and manifest are reproducible and report precision, recall, impact, latency, and fallback outcomes.
notes: Manifest/corpus integration is implemented and consumed by the evaluator in dfa0406. The checked-in artifact is intentionally a scaffold with metrics not_run; real clean-baseline adoption measurement remains tracked separately by crg-69r and its dependencies.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Add Erlang hybrid evidence adapter boundary
description: Add optional ELP, rebar3 xref, and Dialyzer adapter contracts with provenance, diagnostics, fallback, and revision-aware evidence integration.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter failures preserve Generic indexing; valid evidence is observable and provenance-aware; focused adapter tests pass.
close_reason: Adapter contracts, bounded failure handling, provenance, cache, and focused tests implemented in bdba741.

title: Implement Generic Erlang baseline from current main
description: Add Erlang file detection, Tree-sitter baseline nodes, stable identities, syntax evidence, and Generic-only integration for server_flexible.
acceptance_criteria: Erlang .erl/.hrl/.app.src files index through the normal build/update/watch/forget paths without optional semantic tools; focused regression tests pass.
close_reason: Generic Erlang baseline implemented and verified in 29e22cf

title: Verify dirty-file update and restore-to-HEAD consistency
description: Exercise incremental update with an unstaged Erlang edit followed by restoring the file to HEAD, ensuring graph state and identity metadata converge to repository contents.
acceptance_criteria: A production-path regression test proves dirty update, restore, and no-op reconciliation produce the same graph relations and current identity marker as a clean rebuild.
notes: No external dirty-file/restore gate is claimed; the evaluator refuses the current dirty target and records the blocked state.
close_reason: Added automatic Erlang hash reconciliation for working-tree restore cases; production-path test verifies dirty update, restore parity, no-op stability, identity marker, and clean rebuild equivalence.

title: Curate server_flexible Erlang review golden cases
description: Build a fixed-revision corpus from real reviews, incidents, and change questions so Erlang review-context quality is measured against human-confirmed answers rather than smoke queries.
acceptance_criteria: Golden cases record expected callers, dependencies, tests, and impact answers; report resolved-edge precision, Recall@10, impact quality, and an auxiliary-versus-primary adoption verdict.
notes: No golden-case gate is claimed. The checked-in corpus is a scaffold with manual anchors; execute and manually verify cases on a clean pinned target before closing.

title: Establish Erlang performance gates on server_flexible
description: Measure repeatable full-build, one-file incremental, layout-only, and no-op performance on a fixed server_flexible revision. The current 178.70 second full build is smoke evidence, not an adoption pass.
acceptance_criteria: Record the repository revision, machine/profile, warmup policy, repeated timings, thresholds, and pass/fail verdict for full and incremental paths.
notes: No performance gate is claimed. dfa0406 correctly reports latency not_run when the target preflight is blocked; measure only on a clean pinned target.

title: Validate Erlang review context on server_flexible
description:
## Summary
Evaluate the corrected implementation on a fixed server_flexible revision using real code questions and stage timings. This determines auxiliary versus primary review-context adoption; it is not an upstream merge task.

## Steps to Reproduce
Build server_flexible at a recorded revision, run curated callers/include/record/callback/tests-for/impact questions, and time full, one-file incremental, layout-only, and no-op paths.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation records repository revision, profile, real questions with expected answers, precision/recall/impact observations, full and incremental timings, and a defensible adoption verdict. No upstream PR is created.
notes:
Latest implementation smoke (not an adoption pass): server_flexible revision bc8a4424ffd70006ba482f15aa7c61199af34b71; fresh identity v5 graph at /tmp/crg-server-flexible-v5; 1084 indexed files / 975 Erlang files; 15974 nodes / 92349 edges. Full build completed, but the wrapper's result-summary bug meant this run did not capture a defensible elapsed time. Queries verified callers_of args:validate/2 (4 callers) and callees_of args:validate/2 (args.validate_impl/2). Earlier measured run was 178.70s with 1099 files / 15978 nodes / 91180 edges. Current verdict remains Erlang navigation and auxiliary review context; golden-case precision/Recall@10/impact and repeatable performance gates remain open.
Evaluator dfa0406 is available and was run against the configured external target. The current report is blocked: target HEAD 207d6067 differs from pinned bc8a4424, worktree is dirty, apps/server_mongodb checkout differs from its gitlink, ELP/erlang_ls/elp-ls are unavailable, and configured OTP 25 differs from runtime OTP 27. No primary adoption verdict is claimed; rerun after freezing a clean matching baseline and completing performance/golden measurements.

title: Report bounded Erlang AST walk truncation
description: The Generic Erlang walker caps named descendants at 100000 but currently truncates silently. Preserve the bounded behavior while attaching an observable file diagnostic whenever the cap is reached, with regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: A legal Erlang AST exceeding the walk budget remains bounded and emits a deterministic erlang diagnostic; normal files remain unchanged; focused parser/lifecycle tests pass.
close_reason: Bounded Erlang traversal now raises a deterministic parse error; full-build regression confirms no partial file graph and leaves identity pending.

title: Expose Erlang integration diagnostics from forget CLI
description: The public forget command calls forget_files, which returns an erlang_integration status and diagnostics, but cli.py currently prints only file counts and reparsed files. Surface the integration status and bounded diagnostics consistently with build, update, and postprocess so optional adapter failures are observable.
acceptance_criteria: The public forget command with a degraded Erlang lifecycle prints the integration status and diagnostic code; ordinary forget output remains unchanged; add a focused CLI regression test.
close_reason: Forget CLI now prints Erlang integration status and diagnostics; focused CLI tests pass.

title: Stabilize watch reconciliation tests under full-suite execution
description: Hermetic full-suite runs on main intermittently fail existing watch reconciliation tests even when tests/test_erlang_adoption.py is excluded. Observed failures include startup stale-file callback/postprocess warning, Python import re-resolution after deletion, and repair re-read after watcher outage; isolated reruns are inconsistent. Determine whether this is a runtime race or test isolation leak and make the watch contract deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated hermetic full-suite runs do not intermittently fail the affected watch reconciliation cases, and targeted tests use deterministic coordination rather than timing assumptions.

title: Fail closed on Erlang analyzer recursion errors
description: A legal deeply nested Erlang AST can exceed Python recursion depth. The parser records an error, but the public build wrapper still reports status=ok with zero semantic content, allowing incomplete graphs to feed review queries.
acceptance_criteria: Use bounded/iterative traversal or a safe equivalent, and ensure public build/eval paths surface parse errors as non-success. Cover legal nested Erlang input without weakening ordinary parse-error reporting.
close_reason: Iterative Erlang traversal and degraded build status are now enforced at parser, build, and public CLI/evaluator boundaries; focused regressions pass.

title: Normalize escapes in quoted Erlang atoms
description: Normalize escaped characters in quoted Erlang module and function atoms so equivalent source spellings resolve to canonical static MFA identities.
acceptance_criteria: Parser and resolver tests cover escaped quoted atoms, preserve conservative dynamic-call handling, and resolve only semantically equivalent canonical identities.
notes: Also cover legal quoted module/function atoms containing MFA identity delimiters; current colon/slash serialization is ambiguous in addition to escape normalization.
close_reason: Shared quoted-atom normalization and MFA parser now cover escaped delimiters, conservative validation, resolver and public query paths; focused tests pass.

title: Improve Erlang record and header review-context recall
description: Evaluate review queries that depend on record fields and included headers, then close verified recall gaps needed by server_flexible reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-revision cases include expected header importers and record consumers, with measured recall and no cross-application include regressions.

title: Improve Erlang tests_for recall across helper chains
description: Evaluate and improve tests_for results where Erlang tests reach production functions through helper modules or setup chains, without lowering precision through speculative edges.
acceptance_criteria: Production-derived cases demonstrate the current miss, the corrected graph returns the expected tests within the agreed rank, and false-positive behavior remains bounded.

title: Harden Erlang query aliases and adoption documentation
description:
## Summary
Bound public Erlang MFA alias parsing so malformed arities cannot crash MCP/CLI queries, and align README/custom-language examples with the experimental auxiliary-review-context adoption boundary.

## Steps to Reproduce
Query callers_of with an MFA containing more than Python's integer digit limit; compare README claims with the server_flexible adoption gate.
acceptance_criteria: Oversized or out-of-range arities return a bounded not_found result without broad fallback; normal aliases remain covered; README states experimental auxiliary scope and repository-specific adoption gates; stale built-in Erlang custom-language example is removed.
notes: Final ship-gate regression: public max_results accepts integers too large for SQLite LIMIT and raises OverflowError instead of returning a bounded response.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.
